page.overview:
Who is A-Wet-man?

When the Just-A-League was manipulated by Kranky, master of time, Leaks Luthor and the Jokester to fight against the Revengers, A-Wet-man confronted Silas Mariner but, instead of fighting, they chatted in a civilized fashion while having tea. They later joined in an all-out fight, because it was good for sales.
